body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a script, test suite, and generated artifacts to build and validate a bounded Semantic KG Procedure and Worked-Solution Pilot. The review feedback highlights several opportunities to improve the robustness and performance of the script, including adding array guards to prevent runtime TypeErrors, optimizing a linear scan inside a loop to O(N + M) complexity using a Map, and removing a redundant function call that performs duplicate file reads.
